title: Stack Master
core_loop: A moving block oscillates horizontally above the tower. Tap at the precise moment it aligns with the previous layer to drop it perfectly. Each perfect drop keeps the full width; misaligned drops shear off the overhang, narrowing the next layer. Stack 15 layers to win — miss once and the run ends.
controls: Single tap/click anywhere (or Spacebar) to drop the moving block. No horizontal control — timing is the only skill. Touch-friendly: entire screen is the drop zone.
mechanics: Horizontally oscillating block that moves faster each layer (140 -> 320 px/sec)
Alternating left-to-right and right-to-left spawn direction each layer
Overlap calculation: only the intersecting portion of the moving block becomes the new layer
Perfect drop detection within 6px tolerance — restores full width, grants combo bonus
Progressive narrowing: each miss or imperfect drop reduces the next layer's width
Layer descent animation: all existing rows shift down smoothly when a new layer lands
Offcut physics: sheared pieces fall away with rotation and fade for visual feedback
Speed scaling: each layer increases oscillation speed by 8 px/sec up to a cap
juice: Camera flash (90ms, warm gold) on every perfect drop
Particle burst (gold, 10 particles) at perfect drop impact point
Floating 'PERFECT' text with combo multiplier (x2, x3...) that rises and fades
Smooth cubic-ease row descent animation (160ms) when new layer locks in
Offcut fall-away animation with random rotation and fade (500ms)
Pulsing 'TAP TO DROP' prompt with alpha breathing animation during attract mode
Intro banner with tap-hint indicator that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds
Color-cycling palette across layers (cyan, magenta, yellow, green, orange, purple)
Game-over/win end card with final score, retry and CTA buttons (via Juice toolkit)
mvp_scope: Single-screen vertical stacking game, 800x450. 15 target layers to win. Base row 260px wide, 28px tall. All graphics are procedural Phaser rectangles with strokes — zero external assets. Oscillating block spans full width on layer 1, narrows with each imperfect drop. Score = 10 per layer + 20*combo on perfect drops. LocalStorage high-score persistence. Keyboard (Space) and touch/click input. 60fps target on mobile.
win_lose_condition: Win: Stack 15 layers (any width > 0) — triggers victory end card with final score. Lose: Moving block has ≤4px overlap with previous layer on tap — instant game over with miss animation. No partial credit; one miss ends the run. High score tracked across sessions.
